all figures — pending interview, domain encoding sheet, Aviation Operations.

Per operator:
- mtow, mzfw — maximum take-off / zero-fuel weight limits by aircraft type and configuration
- fuel_minimum — sector fuel policy and reserve basis
- performance_distance — runway, temperature and QNH-qualified performance figures
- fdp_limit, rest_requirement — the FTL scheme in force
- delay_cost, handling_rate — station- and shift-rated cost figures
- weight_limits, performance_data, mel_interval, duty_limits, contract_rate,
  fuel_price, compensation — artifacts the staleness triggers key on, not
  figures in their own right; declared so the trigger has something to be
  keyed on (see manifest.yaml quantities)
